# fq = Fq = Pallas scalar field = Vesta base field, modulus 0x40000000000000000000000000000000224698fc0994a8dd8c46eb2100000001
# Every field element is 64 hex chars = 32 bytes little-endian canonical repr (ff::PrimeField::to_repr). `none` = the operation returns None.
# add|sub|mul a b r ; sqr|neg a r ; inv a r|none (none for a=0)
# sqrt a r|none (none when a is a non-residue; r is one root, either root is mathematically valid)
# from_uniform64 <64 bytes hex> r : FromUniformBytes<64>::from_uniform_bytes (little-endian 512-bit integer mod p)
# from_uniform48 <48 bytes hex> r : FromUniformBytes<48>::from_uniform_bytes (little-endian 384-bit integer mod p; used by hash-to-curve)
# from_repr <32 bytes hex> r|none : PrimeField::from_repr, none for non-canonical (>= modulus)
